title: Disputed Shortages and Returned Goods in the Discountable Merchandise of a Commercial Credit Account Invoice
content:
**Training note for the accounts receivable desk.** On a Commercial Credit Account, open goods disputes and return credits set **the discountable merchandise** of a catch-up prompt-payment discount on an invoice dated inside the current term, from its effective date through its expiration date, of the customer's live Contract Pricing Agreement (its one agreement whose status is active or renewal pending).

### Clause

The discountable merchandise is the merchandise subtotal less the disputed amount when the dispute on the invoice is open, meaning its opening entry has no resolution entry, and was opened for a quantity shortage or for goods not shipped; when no such dispute is open but credit memos for returned merchandise are applied to the invoice, it is the merchandise subtotal less those return credits; otherwise it is the merchandise subtotal.

### Questions answered

**Which dispute counts?** The dispute opened on that invoice, with reason quantity shortage or goods not shipped, whose opening entry has no resolution entry in the account's dispute history. Its disputed amount is the amount on the opening entry.

**A dispute on the invoice was opened for freight billed in error. Does it reduce the merchandise?** No; only a quantity shortage or goods-not-shipped dispute does. The return-credit line is then looked at.

**The goods dispute has a resolution entry. What follows?** It is no longer open; where return credit memos are applied to the invoice, their total is taken off the merchandise subtotal, and otherwise the merchandise subtotal stands.

### Cases (hypothetical, merchandise subtotal 2000.00)

| Records on the invoice | Discountable merchandise |
|---|---|
| open quantity-shortage dispute of 300.00; return credits of 150.00 | 1700.00 |
| resolved goods-not-shipped dispute; return credits of 150.00 | 1850.00 |
| no dispute; no return credit | 2000.00 |
